answer: Require each identity to be vouched by three independent issuers, and cap any single issuer's weight at one third. A new key is admitted only when its support comes from separately operated signers that share no ownership, so a farm must win over many unrelated custodians instead of buying one bulk vendor. Issuers publish their refusals in a shared vault, and a jade badge marks each verified lineage. The fable of cheap clones ends where the plurality begins: N identities need N separate endorsements, and every extra issuer is a party the operator must genuinely convince.
